title: BE rejects role create with unknown bundle code
preconds: Authenticated as a user with role-create permission.
steps:
1. POST /api/roles with name='QA Bad Bundle' and fePermissions=['WORK_ORDERS_VIEW', 'NOT_A_REAL_BUNDLE'].
2. Inspect response status.
3. Inspect response body for error detail.
expected: Status 400 (or 422). Body identifies 'NOT_A_REAL_BUNDLE' as unknown. Role is NOT created (verify by listing roles).
